_comment: Per-model facts for the OpenAI benchmark runners. A model not listed here is an error, never a default. api: chat = Chat Completions, responses = Responses API (the pro and codex models refuse Chat Completions). max_output_tokens: the most the runner may ask for (reasoning included); a larger --max-tokens is lowered to it. service_tiers: the tiers the model was seen to accept (IDEAS.md, tier probe 2026-11-19); 'default' means no service_tier is sent. Only gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, the three tier rows and the Responses-only models are measured; rows with a note are assumptions, so correct them when a real run shows otherwise. price_usd_per_mtok: standard-tier list price in USD per million tokens. price_source: the row text copied verbatim from the raw bytes of https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, fetched 2026-11-21 (UTC) with a plain HTTP GET; the file is reference/openai-pricing/2026-11-21/pricing.html (outside git), sha256 2e139336f689aa9fc903ee74842e4ca01f261665bfbdef7cd36fcb5d7f29698a, and the rows were cut out by reference/openai-pricing/2026-11-21/extract_prices.py. A row is the page's own data for its standard-tier table ([0,name], then the numbers in page order: input, cached input, optional cache write, output; the first number is the input price and the last is the output price, checked against the page's rendered table for gpt-6.2-astra, gpt-6.2-sol and gpt-6.1-sol); " is the page's HTML escape for a double quote. gpt-5.3-codex is not in the standard-tier table: its row is from the page's Codex table, whose headings are Input, Output, Cached input. clients/openai_review.py (model_prices) reads price_usd_per_mtok to compute est_usd; a model with no price counts at the highest listed price. clients/test_openai_review.py class RealPriceTests checks every price against the real file, the fallback, a ledger row and the cap check; bench/reviewer/run_openai.py load_models type-checks both keys. KNOWN LIMIT: model_prices has no service-tier input, so a fast-tier call is priced at the standard rate (no call uses the fast tier today). KNOWN LIMIT: gpt-5.5, gpt-5.5-pro and gpt-5.4-pro are listed on the page for requests under 272K context length only; a request over 272K context is priced at the same rate here, which under-states it.
